model.name: Wellness Platform — Motivation & Strategy
model.documentation: Motivation and Strategy layers derived from the wellness platform requirements/rules catalogue. Generated; see gen_motivation_strategy.py.

element.name: Member / Citizen
element.documentation: The wellness participant who enrols in challenges, earns Sahatna Points and redeems rewards.

element.name: Department of Health (ADPHC/DoH)
element.documentation: Programme sponsor, regulator and prize authority. Winners/prizes sit on the off-platform DoH trust boundary (RULE-333).

element.name: Reward Partner / Aggregator
element.documentation: Voucher and merchant providers (incl. UAE aggregators YouGotaGift/Reloadly and direct e&) supplying redeemable value.

element.name: Programme Administrator / CMS Author
element.documentation: Authors challenges, segments, scoring plans and surveys; operates the programme.

element.name: Fraud & Integrity Analyst
element.documentation: Owns gaming/abuse risk and inline integrity checks on the value path.

element.name: Platform Operator / Engineering
element.documentation: Owns maintainability, evolvability and operability of the platform.

element.name: Healthier, rewarded life
element.documentation: Sustained wellbeing plus a rewarding, trustworthy earning experience for the member.

element.name: Population-health ROI & accountability
element.documentation: Demonstrable, auditable public-health outcomes and programme accountability for the DoH.

element.name: Population health & behaviour change
element.documentation: Drive sustained healthy behaviour across the population (DoH mandate).

element.name: Member engagement & retention
element.documentation: Keep members active and returning across multi-week challenges.

element.name: Reward-economy trust & financial integrity
element.documentation: Points have real monetary value; the economy must be trustworthy and balanced.

element.name: Fraud, gaming & abuse risk
element.documentation: Rewards attract gaming of activity, scoring and redemption.

element.name: Regulatory & data-protection compliance
element.documentation: UAE PDPL, health-data sensitivity, 7y retention obligations.

element.name: Partner ecosystem viability & redemption reliability
element.documentation: Redemption depends on a viable, reliable partner/aggregator network.

element.name: Auditability & reproducibility
element.documentation: Scoring/eligibility decisions on a money path must be replayable and auditable.

element.name: Programme agility & evolvability
element.documentation: The programme must adapt cohorts, scoring, rewards and partners without re-engineering.

element.name: Scoring that can't be audited or replayed erodes trust
element.documentation: If how a score was reached cannot be reproduced or explained, members and the sponsor cannot trust the rewards.

element.name: Letting analytics drive money or live state would jeopardise integrity
element.documentation: Operational decisions and value must rest on authoritative records, not on derived analytical copies.

element.name: Unverified activity enables gaming
element.documentation: Without a verification gate, self-reported/raw activity can be gamed for rewards.

element.name: Engagement decays without timely nudges
element.documentation: Members disengage if recognition and nudges are not timely and contextual.

element.name: Fragmented partner coverage slows reward redemption
element.documentation: Integrating each reward provider individually is slow and leaves gaps in coverage.

element.name: Coupling analytics to operations would slow the member experience and limit agility
element.documentation: Tying the live member journey to analytical processing would harm responsiveness and the ability to change cohorts quickly.

element.name: Drive sustained healthy behaviour change
element.documentation: Members adopt and sustain measurably healthier behaviour.

element.name: Operate a trustworthy, auditable reward economy
element.documentation: A balanced, tamper-evident points economy redeemable for real value.

element.name: Reproducible, version-pinned scoring & eligibility
element.documentation: Every scoring and eligibility decision is exactly replayable.

element.name: Let analytics and operations evolve independently
element.documentation: The insight/decisioning plane and the live member-experience plane can each change without disrupting the other.

element.name: Reliable partner redemption & reconciled settlement
element.documentation: Members redeem reliably; partner settlement reconciles to the ledger.

element.name: Regulatory-compliant data handling & consent
element.documentation: Consent-driven, PDPL-compliant handling of personal and clinical data.

element.name: Prevent fraud & gaming of rewards
element.documentation: Gaming of activity, scoring and redemption is detected and blocked.

element.name: Maximise engagement via recognition & nudges
element.documentation: Timely recognition, streaks and nudges keep members engaged.

element.name: Segments built (local) or consumed (clinical), reproducibly
element.documentation: Local segments are built and version-pinned by the platform; clinical segments are consumed from the external builder; both reproducible.

element.name: Real-time, consistent enrolment eligibility
element.documentation: Members are enrolled immediately against a stable, consistent eligibility basis.

element.name: Scores computed consistently and reproducibly
element.documentation: Identical activity yields identical scores, every time, and can be re-derived.

element.name: Rewards earned are credited reliably and transparently
element.documentation: Earned rewards reach the member's balance dependably and visibly.

element.name: Members redeem rewards reliably and promptly
element.documentation: Redemption succeeds within the expected time and the reward is delivered.

element.name: Partner settlements reconcile accurately
element.documentation: What partners are paid reconciles to what members redeemed, with discrepancies surfaced.

element.name: Only genuine, verified activity earns rewards
element.documentation: Unverified or gamed activity does not earn rewards.

element.name: Members receive timely recognition and encouragement
element.documentation: Recognition and nudges arrive at the moments that sustain engagement.

element.name: Past decisions are auditable and reproducible
element.documentation: Any historical scoring or eligibility decision can be reconstructed for audit.

element.name: Reproducibility by design
element.documentation: Once a decision is published its basis is fixed, so the decision can always be reproduced.

element.name: Operational & financial records are authoritative
element.documentation: The system of record governs live state and money; analytical copies are never the source of truth.

element.name: Rewards are earned only on verified activity
element.documentation: Trust in the economy depends on rewarding genuine, verified behaviour.

element.name: Manage the reward economy to financial-grade integrity
element.documentation: Balances are accurate, auditable and never silently lost or duplicated.

element.name: Check integrity before any value moves
element.documentation: No value is transferred without an integrity check.

element.name: Information shared between capabilities is consistent & traceable
element.documentation: Shared information has a known, evolvable meaning and can be traced end to end.

element.name: Scoring policy is business-owned and changeable without code
element.documentation: The business defines and versions scoring rules as governed policy, not engineering changes.

element.name: No action is rewarded or charged twice
element.documentation: Repeated or retried requests never double-credit or double-charge a member.

element.name: Loosely couple capabilities so each can change independently
element.documentation: Capabilities depend on each other as little as possible to maximise evolvability.

element.name: Build local segments & consume external clinical segments
element.documentation: DoH defines features; the platform builds versioned local (demographic/telemetry) segments and consumes externally-built clinical segments (Clinical Team/Malaffi).

element.name: Author & publish challenges with frozen eligibility
element.documentation: CHAL-SVC: challenge lifecycle + frozen {segmentId,segmentVersion} binding.

element.name: Verify activity & clinical signals before scoring
element.documentation: ACTV-SVC/CLIN-SVC: emit activity.verified only on validated, normalised input.

element.name: Score goals, streaks, weekly & challenge scores
element.documentation: SCORE/GOAL/STREAK/BADGE: daily goal, streak tiers, weekly & challenge score.

element.name: Maintain the member rewards balance with reservations
element.documentation: Keep an accurate member rewards balance, holding (reserving) amounts during redemption until confirmed.

element.name: Operate marketplace redemption with partner adapters
element.documentation: MARKET-SVC: redemption via PartnerAdapter, routing policy, failure sweepers.

element.name: Manage partner lifecycle KYB→…→settlement→offboard
element.documentation: Partner lifecycle: onboarding/KYB, contracting, redemption, settlement, offboarding.

element.name: Provide engagement & nudge across the journey
element.documentation: NUDGE-SVC: contextual nudges across enrolment and earning loop.

element.name: Manage consent & identity per PDPL
element.documentation: CONS-SVC/ID-SVC: consent purposes, identity & auth.

element.name: Provide reliable information exchange between capabilities
element.documentation: Capabilities exchange information dependably and in order, with no loss.

element.name: Provide analytics, warehousing & reporting
element.documentation: Consolidated data for population analytics, insight and reporting.

element.name: Enforce fraud & integrity checks inline
element.documentation: FRAUD-SVC: synchronous integrity check on the value path.

element.name: Eligibility basis is fixed at publish
element.documentation: A challenge's eligibility criteria are frozen when it is published, so enrolment is reproducible and auditable.

element.name: Live member reads resolve in real time from authoritative records
element.documentation: Enrolment and earning reads meet the real-time latency budget and never depend on the analytics plane.

element.name: Reservation 300s; partner timeout 10s; 3 retries then release
element.documentation: Redemption timing & retry discipline (RULE-210/211/212).

element.name: Settlement: 5% holdback, 30-day dispute, 0.1% discrepancy
element.documentation: Settlement controls (RULE-214/215).

element.name: Retain 7y; mask PII at 2y; 90-day offboarding wind-down
element.documentation: Data retention & partner offboarding (RULE-206/218).

element.name: Withdrawal is irreversible: progress voided, no reward credited
element.documentation: On withdrawal, accumulated progress is voided and no reward is credited.

element.name: WeeklyScore capped at 100; Points = score×10, never reset
element.documentation: Scoring/points invariants (RULE-318/319/321).

element.name: Winners/prizes are off-platform (DoH boundary)
element.documentation: Prize award sits outside the platform trust boundary (RULE-333).

element.name: Local Segmentation (platform) & Clinical Segment Consumption (external)
element.documentation: Build versioned local segments on the platform; consume clinical segments built externally by the Clinical Team on Malaffi.

element.name: Challenge Lifecycle Management
element.documentation: Authoring, publishing, enrolment, conclusion of challenges.

element.name: Wellness Scoring & Recognition
element.documentation: Goal/streak/badge scoring, weekly & challenge aggregation.

element.name: Activity & Clinical Verification
element.documentation: Validate and normalise activity/clinical signals.

element.name: Reward Points & Wallet
element.documentation: Ledger, reservations, credits.

element.name: Marketplace & Redemption
element.documentation: Catalogue, redemption, partner adapters.

element.name: Partner Lifecycle & Settlement
element.documentation: KYB, contracting, settlement, offboarding.

element.name: Engagement & Nudging
element.documentation: Contextual nudges and recognition.

element.name: Consent, Identity & Compliance
element.documentation: Consent purposes, identity, data-protection.

element.name: Fraud & Integrity
element.documentation: Inline and async integrity checks.

element.name: Integration & Interoperability
element.documentation: Reliable information exchange and integration between capabilities and partners.

element.name: Analytics & Insight
element.documentation: Consolidated analytics, insight and reporting over programme data.

element.name: Separate analytical insight from operational delivery
element.documentation: Keep the live member experience fast and reliable while population analytics and decisioning evolve independently behind a clean boundary.

element.name: Deliver as modular, independently-evolvable capability services
element.documentation: Organise the platform as cohesive capabilities that can be changed and scaled independently.

element.name: Govern scoring as versioned, business-owned policy
element.documentation: Treat scoring rules as governed, versioned policy the business controls and can replay, rather than embedded code.

element.name: Run rewards as financial-grade accounts
element.documentation: Operate the points economy with the integrity, auditability and controls of financial accounting.

element.name: Source rewards through aggregators for fast, broad coverage
element.documentation: Partner via reward aggregators to obtain broad UAE coverage quickly, with direct integrations where warranted.

element.name: Protect reward integrity at every transaction
element.documentation: Guard every value-bearing transaction against fraud and double-processing.

element.name: Scoring policy library
element.documentation: The governed, versioned library of scoring rules and recognition criteria.

element.name: Partner network & catalogue
element.documentation: Contracted partners and redeemable catalogue.

element.name: Member activity & clinical data
element.documentation: Member-generated activity and clinical signals used to recognise wellness behaviour.

element.name: Sahatna Points reward economy
element.documentation: The points currency as a managed asset.

element.name: Earn & Redeem Wellness Rewards
element.documentation: Member value stream: Identify cohort -> Enrol -> Earn/Score -> Recognise -> Redeem -> Settle.

element.name: Financial-services regulatory compliance (AML/SVF)
element.documentation: Points redeemable for real value may constitute a CBUAE stored-value facility; AML & sanctions-screening obligations apply (gap #4).

element.name: ADHICS / health-data compliance
element.documentation: Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information & Cyber Security standard governs clinical-data handling (gap #8).

element.name: AML / Stored-Value controls
element.documentation: Transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and stored-value-facility controls over the points economy (gap #4).

element.name: PDPL data-subject rights
element.documentation: Access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection over personal & clinical data (gap #7).

element.name: Minimal PII to partners
element.documentation: Disclose the least PII necessary to partners on the redemption path; data minimisation (gap #9).

element.name: Erasure reconciled with the immutable ledger
element.documentation: Right-to-erasure satisfied via crypto-shredding/tombstoning without breaking the append-only ledger (gap #7).

element.name: Clinical signals handled as special-category data
element.documentation: CLIN-SVC data classified and protected as special-category per ADHICS (gap #8).

element.name: Data residency & cross-border-transfer controls
element.documentation: Enforce UAE data residency; restrict/secure cross-border PII transfer to global partners (gap #9).

element.name: Title & Progression (recognition tiers)
element.documentation: TITLE-SVC: member titles, levels and progression recognition.

element.name: Adopt privacy-by-design, consent-led data governance
element.documentation: Govern personal and health data by explicit consent and privacy-by-design, aligned to PDPL and ADHICS.

element.name: Operate the points economy under financial-regulatory controls
element.documentation: Treat the points economy as potentially regulated stored value, with AML/KYC-grade controls.
